text: May, nineteen eighteen. America is about to fly the mail.
asr: May 1918. America is about to fly the mail.

text: The new stamp: a blue plane, in a red frame.
Every sheet goes through the press twice. Red first, then blue.
But on one sheet, the blue went on upside down.
A collector named William Robey bought it. One hundred stamps, twenty-four dollars.
asr: A collector named William Robey bought it. 100 stamps, $24.

text: A week later, he sold it for fifteen thousand.
asr: A week later, he sold it for 15,000.

text: The sheet was cut up, and the planes flew apart.
In twenty twenty-three, a single one sold for just over two million dollars.
asr: In 2023, a single one sold for just over $2 million.

text: Some were lost. Some were stolen.
Number sixty-six vanished in nineteen fifty-five, and has never been found.
asr: Number 66 vanished in 1955, and has never been found.
